references.text: Manoah repeats his prayer for guidance concerning the boy and asks that the angel return to give instructions on how they should raise the child.
Isaac prayed to the Lord for his wife, an example of praying for a family's blessing, just as Manoah prays for guidance regarding his coming child.
Moses prayed to the Lord, showing the pattern for intercession and seeking God's will in important matters.
Moses went out from Pharaoh and prayed to the Lord, an example of turning to God in prayer for guidance and help.
Hannah prayed to the Lord for a child and promised to dedicate the child to the Lord, similar to Manoah's situation with a child who was to be dedicated to God.
An angel from the Lord appeared to Zechariah with a message about a son, parallel to the angel's message to Manoah and his wife.
